<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919159_theRebbe_441" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919159_theRebbe_441__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that specifically when Torah and mitzvos are performed as "chukas" (divine decrees beyond reason), they become "zemiros" (songs) that nullify the world and one's persecutors.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is, "Your statutes were songs to me"</t>
    <t s="2">(specifically "Your statutes"),</t>
    <t s="3">for the intent of the verse regarding "Your statutes" is</t>
    <t s="4">(not [limited] to the category of chukim,</t>
    <t s="5">but rather)</t>
    <t s="6">to all the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="7">for when their fulfillment</t>
    <t s="8">(and likewise their study)</t>
    <t s="9">is from the aspect of the command and decree of the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="10">(in the manner of "Your statutes,"</t>
    <t s="11">"A statute I have enacted, a decree I have decreed"),</t>
    <t s="12">then specifically, "songs were they to me."</t>
    <t s="13">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="14">that this [fact] that all worlds are nullified in existence relative to</t>
    <t s="15">(one detail of the details of)</t>
    <t s="16">Torah,</t>
    <t s="17">is primarily from the aspect that the root of Torah is in Kesser, which is above Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="18">[such that] from the perspective of this level,</t>
    <t s="19">the mitzvos, as well as all the details of the halachos within them,</t>
    <t s="20">are from the aspect that thus it arose in His will, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="21">a will that is above reason.</t>
    <t s="22">For in the aspect of Torah as it is drawn down into Chochmah,</t>
    <t s="23">since the mitzvos and the details within them</t>
    <t s="24">(from the aspect of Chochmah)</t>
    <t s="25">are from the aspect of reason,</t>
    <t s="26">that in order that through tefillin the upper intellects be drawn into the worlds, they must be specifically in such a manner,</t>
    <t s="27">then necessarily there is some value and place-occupancy for the worlds,</t>
    <t s="28">for all the details of the halachos from this aspect are in order that influence be drawn into the worlds,</t>
    <t s="29">therefore it specifies, "Your statutes were songs to me"</t>
    <t s="30">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="31">"in the house of my sojourning,"</t>
    <t s="32">for when his engagement with Torah is in a manner that he knows and feels that all the details of Torah are from the aspect that thus it arose in His will, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="33">("Your statutes"),</t>
    <t s="34">then he feels how all worlds are nullified in existence relative to one detail of the details of Torah,</t>
    <t s="35">and consequently,</t>
    <t s="36">the words of Torah that he studies are for him songs</t>
    <t s="37">(delight and pleasure)</t>
    <t s="38">even in the house of his sojourning,</t>
    <t s="39">for all the persecutions he suffers from his enemies do not occupy any place for him,</t>
    <t s="40">and furthermore,</t>
    <t s="41">that through this it is drawn likewise into the world,</t>
    <t s="42">that the enemies and persecutors are nullified,</t>
    <t s="43">"songs" from the term "to cut off the arrogant."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that all mitzvos are called "eidus" (testimony) because they reveal the essential concealment of the Atzmus of Ein Sof, which is beyond even the encompassing light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And an explanation of the matter in greater depth,</t>
    <t s="2">will be understood by first prefacing the matter of eidus (testimony).</t>
    <t s="3">That this matter is also [present] in all the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="4">(even in the mitzvos of chukim and mishpatim),</t>
    <t s="5">in the manner explained above regarding mishpatim and chukim.</t>
    <t s="6">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="7">as the Baal HaGeulah explains in the maamar beginning "Vayakem"</t>
    <t s="8">"Eidus b'Yaakov v'Sorah sam b'Yisrael,"</t>
    <t s="9">that the reason the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="10">(even the mitzvos of mishpatim and chukim)</t>
    <t s="11">are called eidus is because they draw down and reveal the essential concealment of the Atzmus of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="12">which is above the concealment that pertains to revelation.</t>
    <t s="13">For just as the matter of testimony in its simple sense is specifically about something hidden,</t>
    <t s="14">for regarding something revealed, testimony does not apply,</t>
    <t s="15">since it is revealed,</t>
    <t s="16">and even regarding a matter destined to be revealed, testimony is not required,</t>
    <t s="17">so too is it in spirituality,</t>
    <t s="18">that the Or HaMemalei (the filling light) is a revealed thing that is grasped by the intellect,</t>
    <t s="19">as is known</t>
    <t s="20">regarding the matter of "And from my flesh"</t>
    <t s="21">"I shall perceive G-d,"</t>
    <t s="22">that just as it is clear to a person that there is a soul that enlivens his body,</t>
    <t s="23">for by feeling that his body is alive he knows clearly that this is not from the body itself, but that there is a soul that enlivens his body,</t>
    <t s="24">so too is it regarding the world,</t>
    <t s="25">that by seeing a living world they know with certainty</t>
    <t s="26">that there is a G-dly vitality that enlivens the world.</t>
    <t s="27">And the Or HaSovev (the encompassing light), which is above enclothing in the worlds, is a matter destined to be revealed</t>
    <t s="28">(a concealment that pertains to revelation).</t>
    <t s="29">And as explained in many places,</t>
    <t s="30">that through comprehension of the Or HaMemalei that is enclothed in the worlds,</t>
    <t s="31">which is merely a radiation</t>
    <t s="32">(as is proven from this very fact that it is in enclothing),</t>
    <t s="33">from this one comes to knowledge that there is a light that is hidden from the worlds,</t>
    <t s="34">which is the source from which the radiation in enclothing is drawn.</t>
    <t s="35">And it is analogous to how the intellect itself compels that there is something above intellect.</t>
    <t s="36">And the matter of eidus (testimony) is regarding the Atzmus of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="37">which is above even Sovev,</t>
    <t s="38">which is completely hidden,</t>
    <t s="39">and no knowledge or comprehension applies to it,</t>
    <t s="40">not even knowledge of negation.</t>
    <t s="41">And this is why all the mitzvos are called eidus,</t>
    <t s="42">because they draw down and reveal the Atzmus of Ein Sof, which is above even Sovev.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section distinguishes between the service of "ra'usa d'liba" (will of the heart), which grasps Atzmus but still involves existence, and the service of "kabbalas ol" (acceptance of the yoke), which is true self-nullification like a servant.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And one must understand,</t>
    <t s="2">behold, that the mitzvos are eidus on the Atzmus of Ein Sof is because they are His will, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="3">a will that is above reason,</t>
    <t s="4">and what is the difference between the matter of eidus and the matter of chukim?</t>
    <t s="5">And also one must understand the connection of the category of mitzvos that are called eidus because they are a sign and remembrance,</t>
    <t s="6">the matter of reason,</t>
    <t s="7">with the matter of eidus that is in all mitzvos generally,</t>
    <t s="8">that they testify about the Atzmus of Ein Sof because they are a will that is above reason.</t>
    <t s="9">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="10">that the matter of eidus in the mitzvos in the service of man is the service of ra'usa d'liba (the will of the heart),</t>
    <t s="11">for ra'usa d'liba is the desire for G-dliness that comes from the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="12">through which one grasps the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="13">as the statement,</t>
    <t s="14">"No thought can grasp You at all"</t>
    <t s="15">("You" refers to the innerness and Atzmus of Ein Sof, which is above Sovev,</t>
    <t s="16">which is not grasped by any comprehension,</t>
    <t s="17">not even by the comprehension of negation)</t>
    <t s="18">"but He is grasped by the will of the heart."</t>
    <t s="19">And the service of chukim is the service of kabbalas ol (acceptance of the yoke).</t>
    <t s="20">For the difference between these two services is,</t>
    <t s="21">that in the service of ra'usa d'liba,</t>
    <t s="22">since he has a will,</t>
    <t s="23">even though the will is from the aspect of the connection of the essence of the soul with the Atzmus of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="24">nevertheless, it is still in the category of existence.</t>
    <t s="25">And even when his will is in a state of self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="26">that he does not want anything for himself and all his will is that there be a revelation of G-dliness in the world and that the purpose of the dwelling</t>
    <t s="27">for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms be completed,</t>
    <t s="28">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="29">the very matter of will is [still] existence.</t>
    <t s="30">And the true matter of self-nullification is in the service of kabbalas ol,</t>
    <t s="31">which is like a servant who has no will at all,</t>
    <t s="32">and everything he does is from the aspect of the yoke of the master that is upon him,</t>
    <t s="33">from which aspect he is compelled to fulfill the will of the master.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
